control_profile: Strict causal state gating with a twenty-one-day trend, fourteen-day directional quote-volume support, volatility targeting, drawdown brakes, position and time stops, and capped turnover.
falsifier: Reject if the shorter volume-supported signal cannot preserve positive long contribution in bull, positive short contribution in bear, and nonnegative breadth after realistic costs and folds.
formation_horizon: twenty-one-day per-coin trend confirmed by fourteen-day directional quote-volume share, conditioned on a completed sixty-day BTC state
hypothesis: In the liquid point-in-time top forty, short-horizon trends persist when recent quote volume supports their direction, but each side should trade only in the market state where its IS forward edge exists.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first UTC decision boundary
